From: Bethany Lowe <bethany.lowe@deltahealth.com>

Cc: procurement-ops@deltahealth.com

Subject: Delta Health — portal onboarding + MSA redlines

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start supplier enrollment in Ariba but have a couple of items on our side that affect the MSA and the order form mapping. Attaching our initial redline (from our legal team) and the PO requirements doc. High level asks:

- Confirm if Redwood can support Ariba supplier accept acknowledgement within 24 hours (our standard).
- We need the Order Form to include remit-to and tax-jurisdiction fields; our AP system rejects EDI invoices missing tax jurisdiction.
- Signatory matrix: Delta requires a CFO-level signature for contracts > $1M — we need to confirm signature routing in your DocuSign template.
- EDI/SFTP: can you provide the SFTP hostname and expected file layout (we'll ingest invoices via EDI 810/PO 850).

Attached: Delta_Health_MSA_Redline_v3.docx (redline from external legal), OrderForm_DeltaHealth_PO-Reqs.pdf

Appreciate any early heads-up on gating items so we can keep activation on our target week of May 24.

Best,
Bethany
Bethany Lowe

Bethany — thanks for the packet. Looping Kim from legal to review the redlines and Marissa (ops) to own the portal mapping work. Quick answers up-front:

- Ariba PO ack window: our standard is 48 hours but we can enable 24-hour ack for enterprise accounts; will confirm SLA and any cost impact.
- Remit-to / tax jurisdiction: we can add those fields to the Order Form; need to know expected XML tag names (Delta's EDI mapping doc would help).
- DocuSign routing: we use a signer matrix driven off customer tier — can map to CFO for contracts > $1M but need to confirm your signer identities.
- SFTP/EDI: will share host + schema; Marissa — can you take the lead on EDI layout and sample file?

I attached a short checklist for what we'll need to move the Ariba supplier record live. If possible, please have your IT/legal provide the EDI sample this week.

Thanks — Connor

A few portal/PO notes from ops:
- We can populate remit-to and tax-jurisdiction on the internal supplier record; for EDI we map tax_jurisdiction -> N102 in your invoice EDI extract (confirm if your system expects 'StateCode' or full jurisdiction name).

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Lowe <bethany.lowe@deltahealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Delta Health — portal onboarding + MSA redlines

Hi Bethany / team — I reviewed the attached Delta_Health_MSA_Redline_v3.docx and flagged the items that require negotiation or internal approvals. Summarized below with suggested positions and next steps: 

1) Liability cap — redline lowers liability cap to $250k; our standard is 3x fees or $1M minimum. Recommend pushback and offer a carve-out for security incidents.
2) Data processing & retention — Delta requests restricted data retention window (90 days). We need to confirm customer tier and product usage; propose 180 days for logs, 365 for backups; provide KMS/HSM control language.
3) Indemnification — redline broadens indemnity to include downstream affiliates; suggest narrowing to direct claims and specifying limitations.
4) Change of law / export controls — minor edits accepted.
5) Signature matrix — we can support DocuSign routing to CFO for deals > $1M. Need name/email for Delta approvers to pre-seed signer roles in the envelope.

Action items for Delta legal: please send a tracked-changes version of the MSA with any non-standard clause highlighted and provide the signer name + title for the CFO role.

Also, procurement: please confirm whether Delta requires our SFTP host to be added to a vendor allowlist (some customers have strict IP allowlist policies). If so, Marissa can provide IPs.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Bethany Lowe <bethany.lowe@deltahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Delta Health — portal onboarding + MSA redlines

Kimberly — thanks for the quick read. A couple of answers / clarifications from Delta legal and procurement below: 

- Liability cap: Delta legal will agree to $1M if we add a security carve-out; they prefer 2x fees but can accept $1M with carve-out.
- Data retention: they can accept 180 days for logs but insist on 90 days for transient request logs; requested language attached (see attached updated redline).
- Signature matrix: CFO is Mark D. Hargrove (mark.hargrove@deltahealth.com). He sits outside our Ariba user list so we'll need to route DocuSign to him directly.
- Ariba sandbox: IT has exported a sample EDI PO and will push the file to your SFTP during the sandbox window. They created a supplier token: DH-39482.

Attached: Delta_Health_MSA_Redline_v4_tracked.docx (tracked changes), sample_EDI_PO_850.txt (for Marissa / Ops)

Bethany
